spyBull.text: SPY is the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, an exchange-traded fund that tracks the S&P 500 Index and files regulatory disclosures via ETF-specific forms rather than a standard corporate 10-K.

spyBear.text: Investors should approach SPY with caution, as the absence of any promoted momentum baseline leaves the position vulnerable to sudden reversals without a clear trend tailwind.
